item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. We refuse to confuse greater capability with loyalty to humanity. We must protect human agency before we lose it.

2. We cannot treat superintelligent AI as just another tool. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. We demand that human control—not the race to build first—set the agenda.

3. We believe humanity must choose its own future. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. We will not accept that handover of power as progress.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We face a choice about who gets to shape humanity’s future. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will pursue goals no human chose. We reject the idea that building something more capable than ourselves automatically means building something that serves us. We cannot mistake intelligence for allegiance, or speed for progress. We must put human agency ahead of competitive pressure and demand enforceable limits on development. Our future is not a prize for the first company to cross a technical threshold. We intend to keep it in human hands, and we will organise, speak out and push for the safeguards that commitment requires.
